He always played valorant, but one time I overheard him larping with another player, and he was playing the more feminine role. I thought that was just kids being kids and it's 2025, I wouldn't want to pressure him or anything as it just seemed in good fun. Plus, he seems pretty manly to me, he works out, drinks those white monster energy drinks, and all of his plushies are sharks, which are pretty manly. I was expecting a Labuba to come in the mail and was very excited when I received a package, but as I opened it I realized it was for my son, turns out to be a pair of Pink Thigh High Socks, which was strange. I mean I don't know if that's a girl thing, I've literally never seen a girl in Thigh High Socks like that, but who knows? Maybe it is a man thing but it came off as weird to me, he also has childbearing hips and only works legs at the gym so sometimes I worry. Anyway, let me know, am I overreacting slash overthinking?
